The 1/2 sheet stabilizer criterion yields a two-term integral kernel chain complex with explicit signed incidence, and selected n-1 compositions give a unit-diagonal triangular matrix, excluding integer torsion. For d>=2 the unquotiented Hom complex is simply connected by the published wedge theorem, and 3-cycles generating A_n each fix an explicit point, so Armstrong gives pi1=0; Hurewicz and homological Whitehead recover the wedge homotopy type. For d=1 connected graphs and for d=0 exactly two coloring orbits settle boundaries. Exact quotient CW incidence has been checked for 15 pairs over integers and modular homology, but unbounded correctness rests on the stated proof. value.rationale: This is an exact homotopy classification for the entire natural integer-parametrized alternating-label quotient family, strengthening a motivated prior rational character theorem. Quotienting often creates integral torsion and nontrivial fundamental groups, so their uniform absence is substantive. The explicit split-surjective integer difference complex and group fixed-point generation show why and supply reusable techniques, not merely another numerical rank or an arbitrary finite slice.
